silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no Alice-Diana conflict rule, so Alice and Diana may be selected together if otherwise feasible.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about Alice-Diana mutual exclusion or any conflict constraints, but its READY_TO_MODEL feasible-set summary omits this rule and treats the remaining choice among Alice, Diana, and Ella as unconstrained except by the stated implications.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent stopped at READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 Alice-Diana conflict rule remained unresolved and was silently omitted from the model.

summary: The agent recovered the objective and mandatory-Bob constraints well, but missed the Alice-Diana conflict rule and stopped with that P1 hidden slot unresolved, creating a materially incomplete model.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
